The 11 questions

Read them in order. Each one builds on the one before.

Is there a Creator?

  1. 1
    Can we know that anything is real? →

    Yes. Even doubting proves that something is real, and no one lives as if nothing is.

  2. 2
    Did the universe have a beginning? →

    Yes. Planck’s measurements put its age at about 13.8 billion years. ESA, Planck 2013 (opens in a new tab)

  3. 3
    Does the universe need a cause? →

    Yes. Nothing begins without a cause, so something outside space and time caused it.

  4. 4
    One Creator or many? →

    One. The same laws hold everywhere, which points to one will, not rival gods. Quran 21:22 (opens in a new tab)

  5. 5
    If God exists, why is there suffering? →

    Suffering doesn’t disprove God. The Quran says this life is a test. Quran 67:2 (opens in a new tab)

Revelation and the Prophet ﷺ

  1. 6
    Would the Creator communicate with us? →

    Yes. A Creator who gave us reason and a conscience would not leave us without guidance.

  2. 7
    Who was Muhammad ﷺ? →

    A man his own people said they had never found telling anything but the truth. He began receiving revelation at forty. Sahih al-Bukhari 4770 (opens in a new tab) Sahih al-Bukhari 3902 (opens in a new tab)

The Quran

  1. 8
    Is the Quran preserved? →

    Yes. Pages radiocarbon-dated to 568–645, close to the Prophet’s ﷺ lifetime, are “very close to the form of the Qur’an read today.” University of Birmingham, 2015 (opens in a new tab)

  2. 9
    Does the Quran contain knowledge ahead of its time? →

    Revealed in the 7th century, it describes the embryo growing in stages and the universe expanding. Quran 23:12–14 (opens in a new tab) Quran 51:47 (opens in a new tab)

  3. 10
    The Quran's literary challenge →

    It challenges anyone who doubts it to produce one chapter like it. The challenge still stands. Quran 2:23 (opens in a new tab)

Meaning

  1. 11
    What is the purpose of life? →

    To know and worship God, and to live by His guidance. Quran 51:56 (opens in a new tab)
